scenario_title: Circuit breaker threshold too low, breaker stuck open
title: Elevated 5xx errors on billing-svc
impact: A share of requests failed with 5xx on billing-svc
symptom: [ANOMALY] billing-svc 2026-07-21 10:12-13:12: billing-svc: 203 of 278 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-07-21 10:12 and 2026-07-21 13:12 UTC (peak error ratio 1.0 vs baseline median 0.0). 2 error templates, 2 first seen in this span.
error_templates: circuit breaker OPEN: failure rate <*> above threshold 5%
circuit breaker HALF_OPEN: trial call succeeded

_templates.macro: Config change set {key} {old} -> {new}; ordinary error blips opened the circuit breaker and {svc} returned 503 for healthy downstreams.

culprit.diff:
@@ -104,3 +104,3 @@ breaker.failure_pct
 circuit_breaker:
-  failure_rate_threshold_pct: 50
+  failure_rate_threshold_pct: 5
   # managed by the platform team

rca.macro: Config change set breaker.failure_pct 50 -> 5; ordinary error blips opened the circuit breaker and billing-svc returned 503 for healthy downstreams.

action_items: Add validation bounds and a canary for risky config keys (pool / timeout / retry / flags).
Alert on the error signature `circuit breaker OPEN: failure rate <*> above threshold 5%`.
